pin_regs.reason: Actual RTL captures the data boundary in each original domain; explicit four phase-aligned storage clock inputs split sink count without any normal-cycle delta. The component production bench accounts every existing register. Clock/reset ports are domain controls.

name: qkd_static_kv_return_slots_mc_nc1
structural_change: KV-NCKITS 10-17 (coordinator decision 3, KV-PLAN-CI 2e2d12f42): ci-less successor of the closed qkd_static_kv_return_slots_mc_r5 (qkd_static_kv_return_slots_mc): controller_co shrinks 294 -> 282 b (the legacy pass-through fields are gone); logic otherwise identical to r5. Same outline, faces, recipe and pin rules as qkd_static_kv_return_slots_mc_r5; every pin stays registered at the pin (flop-first in/out, hrst captured by a pin flop); 0 normal-cycle delta (lockstep vs the original with ci held 0).
